treatment: Only native observed-player executor continues independent orders after a refused ProposeDeal and requests the usual re-observation after the batch; no AI weights or Builder safety edits
configuration: Public targeted Domination enable_live_bridge(), fixed stock adaptive rivals, native simulation, 4 players, 60x38 Pangaea, Online speed, max turn 150, focal Gran Colombia, randomized rival civs, pid0 handicap-exempt, identical paired seed/difficulty/options
primary_metric: Paired mean focal Production at T75, reported separately for Emperor and Deity; dead or ended-before-T75 seat counts as zero in fresh aggregate
secondary_metrics: Focal/rival highest Production ratio at T75
Alive at T75 and at game end
Focal Production at T50, T100 and T150
Focal science and military power at T75
Recorded productive improvements and Builder gold buys
sampling_rule: Freeze both binaries and exact source/dependency/compile metadata before any new treatment or fresh-strength game. Consumed seed runs are diagnostic only. Report every assigned seed and terminal result. Pilot and confirmation remain separate; no pooling for a confirmation claim.
confirmation_rule: Play the untouched confirmation only if pilot mean T75 Production is positive at both difficulties and T75 survival is not worse; otherwise record the observed pilot and investigate without claiming a production improvement.
correctness_integration_gate: Regression tests, full native Rust suite, incremental Rust quality, green PR and live ship. This is a correctness repair with no learned parameter; strength claims require the separate prospective measurements.
